seo.title: Who we are — Cameroonian-German foundation, social branch of the IROKO Group
seo.description: Discover the history, mission, values and approach of WAHHF Foundation, and its link with the IROKO Group.

mission.title: Building autonomy through education, health and access to knowledge
mission.p1: WAHHF Foundation starts from a simple conviction: every young person deserves access to education, preventive care, language learning and verified information, without a lack of financial resources or disinformation networks shattering their future.
mission.p2: Based in Yaoundé and Douala, with coordination in Germany, the foundation offers a free programme to learn German/English (A1 to C1) and guidance towards 10 European countries.

values.title: Dignity and respect
values.desc: Every beneficiary is welcomed as an actor in their own journey, never as a customer.

values.title: Integrity and truth
values.desc: We fight false migration promises with rigorous, verifiable information.

timeline.title: Key milestones of WAHHF Foundation
timeline.subtitle: Step-by-step growth in the service of communities.

iroko.title: WAHHF Foundation, social branch of the IROKO Group
iroko.text: The Cameroonian-German multi-sector IROKO Group set up WAHHF Foundation as its non-profit social and philanthropic branch. This support covers running and teaching costs.

support.title: Support the foundation
support.subtitle: You can support our actions with a donation, or offer the foundation a partnership: school, association, company or institution.

etapes.title: Origins of the solidarity initiative
etapes.desc: First actions of educational mutual aid and material support for pupils, between Cameroon and the diaspora in Germany.

etapes.title: Structuring WAHHF Foundation
etapes.desc: Programmes organised around the first five pillars: Education, Health, Entrepreneurship, Environment and Rights & Inclusion.

etapes.title: Becoming the social branch of the IROKO Group
etapes.desc: The IROKO Group makes a structural commitment to fund the running of the foundation.

etapes.title: Launch of the 6th domain: Mobility & Languages
etapes.desc: Opening of the free German Academy (A1 to C1) and publication of verified guidance guides for 10 European countries.
